prognostic_notes.DVT: The diagnosis of concomitant DVT has been identified as an adverse prognostic factor, independently associated with death within the first 3 months after acute PE.
prognostic_notes.meta_analysis: Meta-analysis of 8,859 patients with PE: presence of concomitant DVT confirmed as a predictor of 30-day all-cause mortality (OR 1.9, 95% CI 1.5–2.4), but did not predict PE-related adverse outcomes at 90 days.
prognostic_notes.interpretation: Concomitant DVT can be regarded as an indicator of significant comorbidity in acute PE.

section_5_6_prognostic_assessment_strate.summary: Classification of PE severity and risk of early (in-hospital or 30 day) death is summarized in Table 8. Risk assessment begins upon suspicion and initiation of diagnostic workup.
section_5_6_prognostic_assessment_strate.clinical_action: At early stage identify patients with (suspected) high-risk PE. This setting necessitates an emergency diagnostic algorithm (referenced Figure 4) and immediate referral.
